programme.title: The Forbidden Fruit

programme.title: Prometo Amar-te
programme.desc: A car accident leaves Paige in a coma. When she wakes up and reveals that she is suffering from total memory loss, Leo, her husband, has no alternative but to commit himself to winning her over. For the second time...

programme.title: Confessions of a Young Bride
programme.desc: Meeting an old flame (Geoff Stults) leads a woman (Shannon Elizabeth) to wonder if she's about to marry the right man (Eddie McClintock).

programme.title: Ghostbusters II

programme.title: The President and Miss Wade
programme.desc: Andrew Shepherd (Michael Douglas), president of the United States and widower for just over a year, begins a romance with Sydney Wade (Annette Benning), a consultant for an important environmental organization. This relationship, in the middle of the election campaign, will be taken advantage of by Bob Rumson (Richard Dreyfuss), the opposing candidate, to attack the president.

programme.title: This house is a ruin
programme.desc: Anna (Shelley Long) is a young and attractive violinist who stays for a few days with her boyfriend, the lawyer Walter Fielding (Tom Hanks), in the luxurious apartment of her ex-husband, the great conductor Max Beissart (Alexander Godunov). They are happy, but they want to be even more so. Walter's formula is very simple, happiness is in a little house on the outskirts of New York with its white fence, a dog, two children and a little woman. But, at least for the moment, Anna's intentions do not involve marriage. However, the urgent need to look for a house is imposed when her ex-husband returns suddenly and needs to reoccupy her apartment. Walter turns to his friend Jack (Josh Mostel), a real estate agent, who provides him with a real bargain a few kilometers from New York, a dream house for very little money. After managing to raise the money, the couple buys the house from Estelle, its quirky owner (Maureen Stapleton). But unfortunately, mishaps begin to happen in this fabulous mansion: doorbells burn, the bed sinks, the door falls, steps break, ceilings fall apart, pipes shake and, as the final number, the staircase shatters. But since they still really like the house, with the best of their will they set out to fix the mess. They turn to the service of the unique Shirk brothers, Art (Joe Mantegna), the carpenter, and Brad (Carmine Caridi), the plumber.

programme.title: Absolute power
programme.desc: Luther, a specialist in grand thefts, plans to rob the mansion of a tycoon who is on vacation in the Caribbean. However, the victim's wife appears unexpectedly.

programme.title: the whole truth
programme.desc: Tom is accused of having murdered innocent civilians in El Salvador, fifteen years ago, in a secret military operation. His wife, Claire, is ready to discover the whole truth...

programme.title: The work
programme.desc: After witnessing a Lebanese mafia boss murder an undercover police officer, 16-year-old Miki enters the witness protection program. Suspecting an internal leak, the director of the LKA assigns custody to Sarah Brandt, a first-time agent. Along with an incompetent team, Sarah must hide Miki and her divorced parents in an isolated Italian estate. However, when internal tensions flare and a nighttime attack exposes them to danger, Sarah realizes that they have been betrayed and that the only way to survive is to play by their own rules.

programme.title: When the river rises
programme.desc: The story takes place in Tennessee. Despite the threat of a rising river and a poor harvest, Tom Garvey and his wife Mae, a young farming couple, are determined to preserve the land of their ancestors. But, burdened by debt, Tom is forced to become a scab during a strike at the local steel mill, leaving his wife to run the farm. Upon their return, they have to face not only the flooding of a furious river that can wash away the work of so many years but also a power-hungry landowner who covets the lands of the Garveys and their neighbors to satisfy his ambition.

programme.title: Zooloco
programme.desc: The animals at Franklin Park Zoo adore their kind keeper, Griffin Keyes. When Griffin realizes that he is more comfortable with a lion than a lady, he decides that the only way to get a girl to share his life is to leave the zoo and look for a more glamorous job.

programme.title: 2 Guns
programme.desc: Robert Trench, an undercover DEA agent, takes advantage of gunman Michael Stigman's idea of ​​robbing a bank to get a mob boss out. However, the plan turns out to be exceedingly satisfactory when they get much more money than anticipated and, in addition, Trench's forces do not block their exit. To complicate things a little more. Stigman turns out to be a Navy Intelligence agent who shoots Trench and takes all the money. Soon, a confusing loop will begin in which both forces of the American army will pursue both Trench and Sitgman in a corrupt and dirty plot to each keep the profits. And without anyone expecting it, both Trench and Sitgman discover that they have to work together to be able to survive their own bosses and assault groups and to finally emerge victorious. During the development of the film, Vince Vaughn was going to play Bobby and Owen Wilson was going to play Stig. Also, as a curiosity, in the film's trailer you can hear the song "Die by the drop" from 2010 by the band The Dead Weathers. This song had previously been used in the trailer for Contraband (2012), which also featured Mark Wahlberg and was directed by Baltasar Kormákur.

programme.title: The mask of Zorro
programme.desc: 1821. The Mexican army strives to liberate its country from the Spanish yoke. In the Californias area, the evil Spanish governor, Don Rafael Montero, is about to lose everything. In a last attempt to catch his nemesis, the masked swordsman "Zorro", Montoro prepares to murder three innocents. With the help of two orphans, Joaquín and Alejandro Murrieta, Zorro frees the prisoners. Then he will give both boys a special medallion and flee on his horse, Tornado, after marking Montero with a small "Z" on his neck as a warning. But that same night the soldiers enter the house of a nobleman named Don Diego de la Vega and arrest him since they are convinced that he is the real Zorro. Don Diego's wife dies, he is locked up in prison and his daughter, Elena, is taken to Spain as Montoro's daughter, where he will raise her as if she were his own. Twenty years later, Montoro secretly returns to California and looks for Diego in prison but cannot find him because he is unrecognizable due to age. However, the prisoner does remember the man and with a thirst for revenge like he had never had before, he escapes from prison and decides to put an end to his enemy forever. Along the way he will discover Elena, his daughter, who is as beautiful as her mother when she was murdered. Tired, old and completely destroyed by the years of captivity, Don Diego de la Vega will decide to train an adult Alejandro Muerrieta, now a bandit and rogue, to become the new Zorro and avenge all the suffering that the evil Rafael Montero caused him. At first Anthony Hopkins rejected the role of Don Diego de la Vega because he had unbearable pain in his back. When a laser operation managed to alleviate the problem, he then offered to accept playing the wise old "Zorro."

programme.title: The legend of Zorro
programme.desc: 1850. California has been tortured by the colonizers for years but will finally become the thirty-first state of the Union. Zorro suspects that a group of individuals intend to sabotage this decision for their own benefit, so he will stop them in a heroic feat. At the same time, McGivens, a French baron, is dedicated to blackmailing the inhabitants of California to keep their lands and leaving those who earned their living from the countryside in absolute poverty. Don Alejandro de la Vega, the one nicknamed "Zorro" with his mask, his sword, his horse and his cape, has finally been able to marry the beautiful Elena and has a ten-year-old son named Joaquín. The little boy misses his father, whom he hardly sees, and on the other hand idealizes the figure of his hero, Zorro, without knowing what his true identity is. Alejandro promises to leave the mask behind forever and dedicate himself to his family, but when a new crisis appears in California, he acts once again to solve it. Elena, feeling cheated, kicks her husband out of the house and presents him with divorce papers. At that moment, an old companion of the woman arrives at the scene: the French aristocrat Army. When he finds out about Elena's separation, he immediately begins to court her while attending to his affairs in the secret brotherhood in which he is involved. Now Alejandro will have to choose between alleviating the suffering of the oppressed or returning to his family. But to do so he must defeat the always shady Baron Army. For "The Legend of Zorro" both Steven Spielberg and Robert Rodriguez planned to direct the film, but in the end they did not take the job, although Spielberg did stay on as executive producer.

programme.title: Siege status
programme.desc: Third collaboration between director Edward Zwick and Denzel Washington after "Glory Times (1989)" where he won his first Oscar for Best Supporting Actor and "In Honor of the Truth" (1996) and magnificent hand in hand full of tension between Denzel Washington and Bruce Willis. New York City becomes the target of a wave of terrorist attacks. FBI agent Anthony Hubbard (Denzel Washington) is appointed head of the joint anti-terrorist force and together with CIA agent Elise Kraft (Annette Bening), with important contacts in the Arab-American community, they will be in charge of arresting those responsible. Meanwhile, the government declares martial law and sends General William Deveraux (Bruce Willis) to command the troops in charge of occupying the city.

programme.title: Llamaradas
programme.desc: He was a child when he witnessed the death of his father in an act of service during a fire. Twenty years later, Brian is also a firefighter in Chicago. He is in a difficult trial period led by his brother Stephen who is very demanding of him. Both brothers will try to overcome disputes and memories of the past while an arsonist sets fires in the city.

programme.title: Zooloco
programme.desc: The animals at Franklin Park Zoo adore their kind keeper, Griffin Keyes. When Griffin realizes that he is more comfortable with a lion than a lady, he decides that the only way to get a girl to share his life is to leave the zoo and look for a more glamorous job.

programme.title: Shark
programme.desc: Summer vacation has arrived in the small resort town of Amity Island. While the city council is in charge of making the place a wonderful and entertaining place for tourists, a great threat is approaching, endangering the safety of bathers. The police chief, Martin Brody (Roy Scheider), receives a tip about the disappearance of a young woman on one of the beaches. When they search the terrain, the young woman's dismembered body is found buried in the sand. The coroner's first resolution is that the girl was the victim of a shark attack. The police chief prepares to close access to the beaches but is intercepted by the Mayor. Brody argues with him until the coroner intervenes again and assures that his first conclusion was incorrect, and that the girl died in a terrible accident when she got caught in the propeller of some boat or ship. The police officer resigns and accepts the Mayor's "recommendation." A horde of tourists arrives on Amity Island that same day. While on Chief Brody's watch, a boy is killed by the shark and the truth becomes impossible to hide. A shark hunting specialist named Quin (Robert Shaw) offers his services in exchange for being the only one to receive the entire reward. Anyway, seeing the ferocity of the attacks, Brody asks for help from a marine biologist, Matt Hooper (Richard Dreyfuss), who identifies the shark attack as that of a white shark, one of the most dangerous. Quin, Brody and Hooper will try to hunt the feared animal together before someone else is hurt. The film's soundtrack is composed by John Williams, a highly successful composer who also created the soundtracks for the most renowned films by Steve Spielberg and George Lucas. Among them are those of "Schindler's List" and "Star Wars", in addition to the main theme of the "Harry Potter" saga. The film is based on a novel by writer Peter Benchley.

programme.title: The big shark (Jaws 3)
programme.desc: Third sequel born as a result of Spielberg's famous film "Jaws". When a baby white shark ends up trapped in a water park, the owner decides to use it as a lure to attract more customers. What is not expected is that the mother, an adult shark measuring more than 35 feet, will go looking for him and begins to kill bathers indiscriminately. Mike Brody, the adult son of Police Captain Brody, who killed a killer shark ten years ago, will try to take down the terrifying beast.

Without knowing they were going to meet, Lauren and Jim end up spending more time together than they imagined.

programme.title: elite mercenaries
programme.desc: Billionaire technology CEO Donovan Chalmers hires a group of deadly mercenaries to protect a piece of technology that, if exposed, could destroy the world. Their mission becomes even more risky when Chalmers' daughter is kidnapped by the dangerous terrorist group 'The Pardoners', who will stop at nothing to obtain the valuable and dangerous technology.

programme.title: 22 Balas
programme.desc: A former member of the mafia who has been retired for three years, living a peaceful life dedicated to his wife and children, is attacked one morning by some men and left for dead after receiving 22 bullets. However, after miraculously surviving, he begins searching for Tony Zacchia, the only man capable of daring to kill him. Tony has made only one mistake: failing in his attempt...

programme.title: Red hot
programme.desc: Art Jeffries is an FBI agent with respect problems for his superiors. One day he is assigned to investigate the case of a missing boy, Simon, whose parents have been murdered. After finding him, he discovers that he is a nine-year-old autistic boy with a prodigious ability to reveal supposedly insurmountable government codes.

programme.title: Mutiny on board
programme.desc: In 1787, the ship Bounty made a dangerous journey of 50,000 kilometers. After a month of sailing under strong storms, Captain William Bligh allows the crew to dock on a remote island so that they can rest. After seeing the situation of lack of control among the sailors, the captain insists on returning to the boat to continue his trip. However, the second in command, Fletcher Christian, will support his men.

programme.title: 10 minutes less
programme.desc: Frank is a criminal who, together with his companions, tries to rob a bank. However, the police end up being alerted and while trying to flee, a mysterious assailant hits Frank on the head, causing him to lose part of his memory. Rex, the leader of the gang, awaits answers about the failed robbery, while Frank will try to do everything possible to recover the 10 minutes that have disappeared from his memory and find the person responsible for his fall from grace.

programme.title: Bloodshot
programme.desc: Upon returning from a mission in Mombasa, elite soldier Ray Garrison and his wife are kidnapped and murdered. Shortly after, Ray awakens in the Spirit Reborn Project facility with no memory of his past.

programme.title: The silence of the lambs
programme.desc: Promising FBI agent Clarice Starling is pulled from her special forces training by Jack Crawford of the FBI's Behavioral Study Unit. He wants me to study a notorious and eccentric psychopath named Habbibal Lecter, who was a forensic psychiatrist imprisoned for multiple murders and cannibalism. The purpose of the meetings between Clarice and Hannibal must be for the latter to agree to help her catch a serial killer named Buffalo Bill. But what the woman did not imagine was that Hannibal would turn out to be a sophisticated and cultured man restricted from others by glass walls. Although he is polite at first, he soon begins to lose patience when Clarice tries to create a psychological profile for him. While the hunts continue throughout Chicago and Buffalo Bill collects his kills without the FBI being able to do anything to solve it, Clarice will have to find a way to ingratiate herself with a man who ate the people around him and show him that, in addition to being intelligent, she is not afraid of him at all. Things will start to get difficult when the Senator's daughter disappears and everything indicates that Buffalo Bill has her and that soon her body will appear as a new victim. The events of this film take place after what happened in the film Hunter (1986). Although there are many characters in common in the two films, only two of the actors share films. Frankie Faison plays Lt. Fisk in Hunter and Barney in The Silence of the Lambs; On the other hand, Dan Butler plays the fingerprint expert FBI agent in Hunter and an entomologist in "The Silence of the Lambs."

programme.title: back to the future
programme.desc: Marty McFly is a teenager tired of his family. One day he receives a call from his friend Doc, a scientist whom everyone thinks is crazy, to show him his latest invention. It is a time machine that consists of a car powered by plutonium. Marty accidentally activates the machine, traveling back in time to 1955. In the past, Marty discovers his teenage parents and mistakenly avoids their first date. Marty must reunite his parents, convince Doc that he comes from the future and manage to travel back to the present. Initially, the role of Marty McFly was going to be played by Eric Stoltz. However, in the middle of filming, the directors fired Stoltz when they considered that he was not the right actor. Michael J. Fox, who had been an early choice, was committed to the show Family Ties at the time. However, after Stoltz's dismissal he was available to record the film and immediately accepted the role. Christopher Lloyd plays Doc. Lloyd initially turned down the role, but ultimately accepted it once he read the script. The film's director, Robert Zemeckis, along with the screenwriter, Bob Gale, had already been interested in the idea of ​​making a film about time travel. The final idea came about after Gale reflected on the possibility of having become friends with his father if they had attended the same school. After Back to the Future, Robert Zemeckis directed other successful films such as Forrest Gump, Cast Away and Flight. The success of Back to the Future led to the production of a trilogy, as well as the creation of an animated series.

programme.title: Back to the future II
programme.desc: Marty, his girlfriend Jennifer and Doc travel to the future, to the year 2015, to prevent the couple's son from being imprisoned for a problem with the law. However, the presence of the temporary travelers will cause a bigger problem than the one they intended to fix and things will become increasingly complicated. The problem begins when Marty buys a sports almanac with all the results of the competitions up to the year 2000, in order to make easy money when he returns to the past. As in the first part, Marty McFly and Doc are played by Michael J. Fox and Christopher Lloyd, respectively. However, two of the actors from the first part, Crispin Glover and Claudia Wells, did not participate in the second part. Crispin Glover, who played Marty's father in the first part, was replaced by Jeffrey Weissman, who used facial prosthetics to look as much like Glover as possible. For her part, Elisabeth Shue was in charge of replacing Claudia Wells, who in the first part played Jennifer, Marty's girlfriend. Although the first film was not intended to have a sequel, its box office success motivated Robert Zemeckis to film two more films. After two years spent building the sets and writing the script, filming began in February 1989. Without a doubt, the biggest challenge was creating the futuristic vision of Hill Valley. It should be noted that this second part and the third part of the trilogy were filmed simultaneously.

programme.title: Back to the future III
programme.desc: Stranded in 1955, Marty receives a letter from his friend Doc telling him that he is in 1885 and that the time machine is broken and cannot be repaired. Doc isn't worried about being stuck in the past, saying he's happy working as a blacksmith. However, Marty discovers an old grave in which he reads that Doc died in 1885, and decides to go rescue his friend. Using the time machine Doc had hidden in 1955, Marty travels to the Wild West, where he discovers that his friend has run afoul of a gang of bullies and fallen in love with a teacher. Using technology from the time, Marty and Doc must find a way to return to the future. Since the second and third parts of the trilogy were filmed simultaneously, there are no significant changes in the cast with respect to Back to the Future II, with MartyMcFly and Doc once again played by Michael J. Fox and Christopher Lloyd, respectively. The most notable addition compared to the previous installments is that of Mary Steenburgen, playing Clara Clayton, the teacher with whom Doc falls in love in 1885. The idea of ​​traveling back in time to 1885 arose during the filming of the first film, when Robert Zemeckis asked J. Fox what historical period he would like to visit. Fox answered that it was the Wild West, and Zemeckis and Bob Gale decided to use this idea for the third part. Although the first film was not intended to have a sequel, its box office success motivated Robert Zemeckis to film two more films. After two years dedicated to building the sets and writing the script, filming of the second and third parts (they were filmed simultaneously) began in February 1989. Some scenes were filmed in Monument Valley. The train scenes were filmed at the Railtown 1987 State Historic Park, a historic train line located in Jamestown.

programme.title: No reservations
programme.desc: Kate Armstrong is a brilliant and demanding haute cuisine chef in charge of a famous restaurant. Her perfectionist and meticulous nature means that she does not accept criticism very well, which causes her boss to force her to go to therapy if she wants to continue maintaining her position as a chef. After the tragic death of her sister in a car accident, Kate is forced to take care of Zoe, her 9-year-old niece who has just been orphaned. Her new family situation causes Kate to face real problems reconciling her work day with taking care of Zoe, so her boss decides to give her a few days of vacation so she can adapt to the changes. After a few days of rest, Kate returns to work with more strength. However, upon her arrival the chef meets Nick Palmer, a chef who likes to take risks and bet on new ideas and who has been hired to replace her in her absence. The restaurant manager is delighted with Nick, so she decides to make him a permanent part of the staff, which will cause Kate to feel threatened. Rivalry will arise between both chefs due to their totally opposite characters and their different ways of working. Little by little, Kate and Nick will transform their rivalry into love, a process in which little Zoe will have a lot to do with.

programme.title: It happened in Manhattan
programme.desc: Marisa Ventura is a single, hard-working, intelligent and determined mother who dreams of achieving a better life. While working hard as a cleaner in a luxurious Manhattan hotel, her heart falls in love with Christopher Marshall, a rising politician who, upon seeing her, mistakes her for one of the hotel's high society guests.

programme.title: The clan of the bonebreakers
programme.desc: Paul Crewe is a former quarterback who is serving time in a Texas prison and trying to reform. When former National Football League player Paul Crewe is sent to his same prison, the warden forces him to turn a motley group of inmates into an American football team. Despite the few possibilities of forming a team and the little desire to collaborate, the inmates are motivated when they discover who they are going to play against: the prison guards. With the help of inmates Nate Scarborough and Custodio, Crewe offers his fellow inmates a chance for revenge in an anything-goes showdown.

programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Bruce Banner is a renowned scientist, with a murky family past, who suffers with his team a serious laboratory accident in which everyone is exposed to intense gamma radiation. When he discovers that he is the only one who has survived, he is confused and begins to investigate. But Bruce has developed a terrible ability after the accident that could hinder the investigation; when he gets angry he turns into a giant green monster with irrational and destructive behavior. To create the Hulk character using digital technology, the company Light & Magic made the largest technical deployment in its history. It was necessary to work together with one hundred and eighty ILM technicians and work on the character for more than a year and a half. Even so, there are viewers who have compared the technical quality of the Hulk to that of Shrek. In this film, Hulk reaches the largest size he had reached to date, nine meters tall. Ang Lee used the split-screen technique to cinematically imitate the panels of a comic book page. To do this, he had to shoot the same scene several times, which somewhat exhausted actor Eric Bana, who plays Brece Banner. Much of the microbiology work seen on screen is real, done by Ang Lee's wife.

programme.title: Adoptive parents
programme.desc: Coline and André are in perfect harmony with their daughter, Garance, and their son-in-law Harold. But Garance separates from Harold and orders his parents to never see him again, the in-laws cannot do it. They will have to lead a double life to continue seeing their beloved son-in-law.

programme.title: Exposed
programme.desc: Milo Boyd, a bounty hunter who is going through a bad streak, is assigned the case of his dreams: capturing his ex-wife, journalist Nicole Hurley, who has violated parole. Milo thinks it will be a fun job, but Nicole has run away to investigate a murder, so things won't be so simple. Suddenly, their lives begin to be in danger and they have to flee. If you thought the promise to love and respect each other was difficult, staying alive will be much more complicated.

programme.title: A town called Dante's Peak
programme.desc: Harry Dalton (Pierce Brosnan) is one of the most renowned volcanologists at the United States Geological Survey. Four years after his partner's death during a volcanic eruption in Colombia, Harry receives a call from his boss, Paul Dyfrus (Charles Hallahan), to discuss the unusual behavior of a hitherto dormant volcano. Meanwhile, the city of Dante's Peak, located on one of the volcano's plains, is celebrating being named the second most desirable place to live in the country. Harry begins his investigation in the area and discovers clear signs that the volcano could soon erupt. The scientist wants to put the city on alert, but the inhabitants have economic interests that could be harmed if they heed Harry's warnings. Everyone ignores it until it's too late. The director, Roger Donaldson, was drawn to the project because he was once a geology student. Many of the film's special effects were done practically. The ash from the volcano was actually very fine shavings of newspaper. According to an interview with Donaldson, the camera that Harry Dalton uses during his investigation is actually owned by Pierce Brosnan. Initially the main role was going to be played by Michael Douglas. Most of the film's exteriors were shot in Wallas, Idaho. It was also filmed on Dante's Peak, adding certain details with digital technology.

programme.title: Married Failed

programme.title: Putri Keong Mas

programme.title: Innocence
programme.desc: Seorang pengacara ternama mengungkap konspirasi sebuah desa kecil saat membela ibunya yang diasingkan karena menderita penyakit Alzheimer dan dituduh membunuh para pelayat di pemakaman suaminya.

programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five mengisahkan lima orang biasa yang hidupnya berubah setelah menerima transplantasi organ dari donor misterius yang sama. Tidak lama kemudian, mereka menyadari bahwa transplantasi tersebut memberikan kemampuan luar biasa yang berbeda-beda pada masing-masing orang. Saat masih berusaha memahami kekuatan baru mereka, muncul seorang pria berbahaya yang ingin menguasai kemampuan tersebut demi ambisinya sendiri. Terpaksa bersatu meskipun memiliki latar belakang dan kepribadian yang berbeda, kelima tokoh ini menjalani petualangan penuh aksi, humor, dan tantangan untuk menghadapi ancaman yang mengincar mereka. Dengan nuansa superhero khas Korea, film ini menghadirkan kisah seru tentang kerja sama, keberanian, dan persahabatan.

programme.title: Smugglers
programme.desc: Para wanita penyelam mengalami kesulitan untuk mengumpulkan boga bahari karena adanya pabrik yang baru saja dibangun. Untuk menyambung hidup, mereka mulai melakukan bisnis penyelundupan.

programme.title: The Girl On A Bulldozer (tvN Movies)

Ketika pernikahan itu membuatnya menjadi tawanan di rumahnya sendiri, Hwang Yeo-Re memutuskan untuk kembali ke kehidupan lamanya dan meminta bantuan tetangganya yang ramah.

programme.title: Honeysweet
programme.desc: Chi-ho adalah seorang perancang produk nan sukses, sementara Il-young bekerja di suatu perusahaan pinjaman. Mereka bertemu saat Chi-ho mencoba membayar hutang kakaknya. Kebetulan membuat mereka menjadi dekat.

programme.title: The Childe
programme.desc: Marco, seorang petinju yang lahir dari ayah Korea dan ibu Filipina. Akibat kesulitan keuangan dan ibu yang sakit-sakitan, Marco memutuskan pergi ke Korea Selatan untuk mencari keberadaan sang ayah yang sejak kecil meninggalkannya. Setibanya di Korea Selatan, Marco mendadak menjadi buronan seorang pria misterius dan sekelompok orang jahat yang tak pernah berhenti mengejarnya.

programme.desc: Only Mercedes-Benz can boast this anniversary. The inventor of the automobile celebrates 120 years of motorsport history. programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Saxony's longest automobile museum is coming for the 17th time! Top speed presenter Martin Utberg is taking part in the Sachsen Classic for the fourth time. (Station info).

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: In the stunt factory Action Concept, over 100 cars are wrecked every year for film stunts. In a new episode of the series "Stunt Heroes" a quad driver is chased by a car. (channel info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: The north of Thailand is a popular travel destination, not just for adventurous individual tourists. The north is known for its mountainous, densely forested areas and therefore this region is also a paradise for motorcyclists. Thousands of curves on well-developed roads with little traffic and a diversity of culture and landscape make this region a perfect holiday destination for us to escape the winter in Germany for the fourth time. We will take you on a 1600 km long motorcycle tour to the most beautiful places in northern Thailand. (Station info).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: What is the correct name? The boat, the boat or the boat? Well, today it's the Boot for once, because we're making a little trip to Düsseldorf with Motorvision on Tour and that's where the Boot is taking place and that's the world's largest yacht and water sports trade fair in the entire world. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: At the auctions in the classic car gallery in Toffen, everyone has the opportunity to make an inexpensive bid. In addition to high-priced classic cars, affordable classic cars and entry-level classic cars are also available here. Classic looks around the event. Also: From the American oval circuit to the Swabian Alb - a Ford Fairlane GTA from 1966 in a NASCAR look. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: Saving energy is a must, especially in the automotive industry. It's good that the competition is so great. Developments are in full swing and manufacturers present their latest “green” concepts at every motor show. Motorvision TV takes a close look at current developments and takes a wide variety of aspects into account. What's new in engines? (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: The name Rolls Royce has always stood for exclusivity, luxury and British automotive engineering. The legendary vehicles with the Spirit of Ecstasy on the radiator grille have been built in England since the beginning of the 20th century. Today it is mainly very wealthy people who make the decision to purchase a Rolls Royce. No two ordered models are the same. Because the Bespoke customization department leaves no wish for individualization unfulfilled and so each vehicle is an absolutely unique piece. Made in takes a look behind the scenes at the Rolls Royce factory in southern England. (Station info).

programme.title: Four-wheel drive adventure

programme.title: Perfect Ride

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.sub-title: Electric G-Class and CLA on the Timmelsjoch
programme.desc: Extreme winter test: We chase the Mercedes G 580 EQ onto the snowy Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road and clarify all the advantages and disadvantages of the new electric drive. Does the electric G still feel like a real G-Class? We also drive exclusively in the new, still camouflaged CLA. With modern features and extremely efficient values, the model is intended to redefine entry into the brand. (Station info).

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: The BSG Racing crew is very familiar with spectacular conversions. Dirk Hattenhauer and his boys have already refined quite a few bullets. programme.title: Made in....
programme.sub-title: The history of the fire department
programme.desc: The history of the fire department goes back to Roman times. At that time, it was primarily slaves who had to expose themselves to the burning danger. In the Middle Ages, the guilds were responsible for fighting fires, but it was only with one man that the fire department in Germany was sustainably structured: Conrad Dietrich Magirus. He is considered the pioneer in firefighting technology. To this day, the most modern fire engines are built 100 percent by hand in his hometown of Ulm. MOTORVISION TV takes a look behind the scenes of the company with over 150 years of history and shows the production of turntable ladders and fire engines. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Whether rocket car, Ascona or Calibra, racing has been Opel's engine for over 100 years: just two years after Opel's automobile production began, the first car with the Blitz won a race in 1901. The record attempts with the first rocket vehicle RAK, with which Fritz von Opel wants to set new speed records, are unforgettable. (Station info).

programme.desc: Lots of chrome, free-standing lamp pots, bulbous fenders, swelling shapes wherever you look – typical pre-war look. The four-seater with a mother-in-law seat, presented in 1947, established the long tradition of the British post-war roadster. The 1800 is not a tough corner robber, but rather a comfortable tourer for leisurely country trips. Also in the show: BMW 507 and Porsche 356 Cabrio. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Top speed presenter Martin Utberg visits the company "Vehicle Experts.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: On the Stunt Heroes highway, a skidding truck competes against a remote-controlled Chrysler. Stunt coordinator Domanski's goal: to take off the roof of the Chrysler. If everything goes according to plan, the stunt will result in a new convertible! (Station info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: The north of Thailand is a popular travel destination, not just for adventurous individual tourists. The north is known for its mountainous, densely forested areas and therefore this region is also a paradise for motorcyclists. programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: Motorvision on Tour today in deepest Austria, at Lake Zenz. A particularly cool event takes place here: Snow & Ice Drifting and this is where our presenter will of course learn to drift today. And not with just anyone - he's looking for the coolest professional racing team in rallying. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: The Opel Kadett C is the hit of the seventies. One of the proud owners is René Klauß. In his workshop in the Erzgebirge, he dismantled, sanded, painted and tuned the Rüsselsheimer Mini. Classic takes a closer look at its red flash in the city version. Also: The Orwell Supersports Cup visits Spa Francorchamps and thoroughbred racing driver Hans Hermann in a portrait. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: Pickups are the epitome of the American way of drive! High-displacement V8 engines combined with plenty of space. Rarely seen in Europe, but in the US market they are the cash cows of many car brands. In the future, traditional manufacturers will hardly be able to avoid an electric version of their trucks. And the competition is getting bigger and bigger. Ever since Elon Musk introduced the Tesla Cybertruck, both established brands and new startups have been on the rise to conquer the market: with vehicles that sometimes have over 1000 hp! Ford F-150 Ligtning, Bollinger B2 or Hummer EV – Green Wave shows what will happen in the future (channel information).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: The British county of Chesire, in the tranquil town of Crewe, has been home to one of the most exclusive automobile manufacturers for 70 years: Bentley Motors. 400 hours of pure manual work, meticulous accuracy, a lot of technical know-how and a lot of passion from the employees turn the top model, the Bentley Mulsanne, into a sculpture on wheels. At Bentley, not only luxury traditionally plays a role, but also performance. Bentley Boy Steven Kane chases the Bentley Mulsanne Speed, which goes over 300 km/h and costs around 325,000 euros, around the racetrack. (Station info).

programme.title: Four-wheel drive adventure
programme.desc: Adventure Allrad, a special interest magazine about off-road and all-wheel drive vehicles. The focus is on off-road veterans and cars with four-wheel drive. Today, Adventure Allrad is fielding two “giants” from Bavaria, the BMW X5M and BMW X6M. The new Skoda Yeti is also being presented and Subaru is looking for the all-wheel drive lady. (Station info).

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: SUVs sell like hotcakes. Over 50% market share in Europe in 2024, a record! Compact SUVs are particularly popular and the Dacia Bigster is shaking up the segment. Around 10,000 euros cheaper than the competition is a declaration of war. But is it really good or just cheap and nothing behind it? Also: Five exciting facts about the brand new third generation of the Audi Q3. (Station info).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.sub-title: All-wheel drive fun on and off-road
programme.desc: All-wheel drive is only fun off-road? Absolutely not! And these two are proof: The Subaru Forester is taking off in its new sixth generation. We check its qualities on and off-road and find out the secret of its success. And this all-wheel drive stunner is probably one of the most extraordinary electric cars. Five exciting facts and a bonus about the Hyundai Ioniq 5 N. (channel information) await you.

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: The Monza Rally Show is a classic drift show. The stars of motorsport have been using the fly-off handbrake on the legendary Formula 1 circuit in Monza, Italy, since 1978. Patron and MotoGP star Valentino Rossi and his guests offer fans an unforgettable show. Also in this program: A Mercedes G-Class becomes the ORC Bull special off-roader. Nothing remains the same with the ultimate hunting vehicle for the toughest terrain. And: A Mini becomes a Dakar racer. Rally ace Stephané Peterhansel explains the basics of race tuning on his Mini Rally-Countryman project. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: The well-known Austrian classic car collector Franz Wittner invited Martin Utberg to Königsleiten in the Salzburger Land. His friend Hannes Kröll owns a hotel in the ski resort, and together they cook there at an altitude of 2,300 meters - of course the conversation revolves exclusively around classic cars. In this episode we don't just cook, we also drive in beautiful classic cars. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.sub-title: Mercedes racing: the beginning of an era
programme.desc: Power, passion, pole position – Mercedes has been writing motorsport history for 120 years. The list of successes of the brand with the star is long. As early as 1894, a Daimler and a Benz took part in the first car race. The victories at the French Grand Prix in 1908 and 1914 are outstanding. Car History shows how Mercedes dominated racing from the first automobile race onwards. (Station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: With the Macan Turbo, Porsche sets the benchmark in terms of driving dynamics in the SUV segment. The optional performance package increases output from 400 to 440 hp.
